content.short: D5 Exchange is a decentralized exchange on Ethereum and L2s featuring on-chain order books via Gridex.
content.description: D5 Exchange is a non-custodial trading platform powered by the Gridex Protocol, bringing the efficiency of centralized order books to the decentralized world of Ethereum and its Layer 2 solutions. Unlike traditional AMMs, D5 utilizes a Maker-Order-on-Chain (MOOC) model, allowing users to set limit orders directly on the blockchain without incurring the high slippage of liquidity pools. By combining the speed and precision of an order book with the security of on-chain settlement, D5 provides professional-grade trading infrastructure for both retail and institutional DeFi participants.
content.meta: D5 Exchange offers professional-grade on-chain order book trading on Ethereum. Discover D5 and other DeFi Dapps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
